name: polarrecorder-dev-tooling
description: Polar Recorder developer-only quality tooling (no runtime dependency).

scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:lint && npm run docs:links:proof && npm run docs:links && npm run docs:format && npm run docs:reachability && npm run docs:toc && npm run docs:smell-catalog && npm run docs:pointer
scripts.check:scaling: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python -m pytest tests/test_operation_count_evaluator.py tests/test_polar_model.py tests/test_projection_scaling_contract.py tests/test_api_handlers_scaling_contract.py -q'
scripts.typecheck:python: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; python -m mypy server/polarrecorder tests plugin.py --strict'
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:source && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:tools && npm run typecheck:python
scripts.check:python-contracts: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; PYTHONPATH="$PWD/server${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"; export PYTHONPATH; python tools/check-python-compat.py && python tools/check-py-contracts.py && python tools/check-py-dependencies.py && python tools/check-runtime-contracts.py'
scripts.package:check: npm run schema:check && node tools/release-archive.mjs --dry-run && vitest run --project tools tests/js/release-create.test.mjs tests/js/release-git.test.mjs tests/js/release-prepare.test.mjs tests/js/release-version.test.mjs
scripts.setup: npm ci && bash -ceu 'interpreter="${POLARRECORDER_PYTHON:-python3}"; venv_dir="${POLARRECORDER_VENV:-venv}"; version="$($interpreter --version)"; case "$version" in Python\ 3.14.*) ;; *) echo "setup: $interpreter reports $version; expected Python 3.14" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; [ -x "$venv_dir/bin/python" ] || $interpreter -m venv "$venv_dir"; "$venv_dir/bin/python" -m pip install "pip==26.1.2"; "$venv_dir/bin/python" -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.txt; bash tools/actionlint.sh --install'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:ruff
scripts.check:standard: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run actions:lint && npm run duplication:check
scripts.test:node: npm run test:tools && npm run test:viewer && npm run test:plugin
scripts.test:split: npm run test:python && npm run test:node
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:python && npm run test:viewer && npm run test:plugin
scripts.test:coverage:python: bash -c 'PATH="$PWD/venv/bin:$PATH"; rm -rf coverage/python && mkdir -p coverage/python && python -m pytest tests/ --cov=polarrecorder --cov=plugin --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=json:coverage/python/coverage.json --cov-fail-under=90 --quiet'
scripts.test:coverage:check: npm run test:coverage:python && npm run test:coverage:viewer && npm run check:coverage-inventory
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:standard && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:all: npm run check:core && npm run test:coverage:check
